title: Walking Together
summary: A mother and daughter set out on foot on a long walk to the clinic. When you walk together, singing and looking all around, even a long road becomes a trip full of surprises.
pages:
When we set out on our way and the road is long,
we'll walk along together and sing a happy song.

I'm with you and you're with me.
It's fun to set out with my family.

I'll wrap you up warmly, the way a mother hen does,
who guards her chicks under her wing, just because.

And if rain starts falling from the sky,
like that good old hat, I'll keep your face dry.

If the clouds boom and grumble and rumble on high,
be brave, don't cry.
You're not alone — I'm close by.

We're walking together, so it's never a bore.
Look up! Look around!
See how much we've discovered — and more!

If you see something funny, don't leave me to guess.
Show me too — I don't want to miss it, yes!

If your feet hurt from the long, long road, don't worry — we're here, it's true!
Here's the clinic, waiting for you.

We all need our throats and lungs and ears checked with care.
That's how we grow strong, so no need for tears there.

Does this look scary to you?
Come, give me your hand.
She'll measure your blood pressure with the clever, special band.

They give us our medicine and explain what we need, so we'll all stay healthy and well.
Now we're heading home again — farewell!

It's okay to be tired, we saw so much today.
Now it's time to sleep.
Good night, and sweet dreams to carry you away.
